create_memoized_property: create a memoized property decorator that caches expensive property computation results on first access
use_memoized_property: use the memoized_property decorator on a class property to cache its computed value after first call
create_frozen_class: create a frozen class decorator that prevents setting new attributes on instances after construction
use_frozen_class: use the frozen_class decorator to make a class immutable after its __init__ method completes
review_decorators: review the memoized_property and frozen_class decorators for use in a Python project
